chapter: Chano Pozo, Town Hall and Charlie Parker
title: Granz picks the tunes; the arrangements were already existing
summary: Granz selected pieces from arrangements the band had for a year, and Parker just played over them.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Did he select any of the tunes to be recorded?
Who selected the music to be recorded?
Ahh - Norman Granz. - "I like this number, I like the other one, I like this and this and that" - but for him was ......
They were special arrangements for Charlie Parker?
No, they was arrangements that we had, maybe a year.
Yea, we had - it was nothing new.
.... and Charlie Parker just added in, right?
